# C8 — E2E, demo and hardening

**Tasks:** T8.1 (backend), T8.2 (lead), T8.3-B/M/F (modules), T8.3-D (lead)
**Owner split:** each owner does only their suffix; do not edit another module.
**Read first (only):** this pack, `SETUP.md`, `README.md`, `backend/pyproject.toml`,
`backend/tests/`, `docs/api-contract.md`, `docs/checks.md`.
**Do not read:** full module history, old reference docs.
**Depends on:** C1–C7B.

## T8.1 — Real PostGIS tests

`backend/tests/conftest.py`:

- read `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (default `postgresql://landmarket:landmarket_dev@localhost:5432/landmarket_test`);
- apply `001_init.sql` + numbered migrations once;
- per-test transaction + rollback; skip with a clear message if DB is down;
- marker `integration`, registered in `pyproject.toml`.

Cover: parcel bbox, ALU grid, bundle validation, listing/order transitions, evaluate,
evidence persistence. Add `make test-integration`. Default `pytest` stays fast.

## T8.2 — One-command demo

`scripts/demo.sh`: DB up, seed, API + middleware + frontend background, chain node + deploy
+ smoke, print URLs, cleanup on Ctrl+C. Add `make demo`.

`docs/demo-script.md`: the 7-step MVP script, expected output, and fallback when the TinyFish
key is absent (show the documented smoke proof, do not fake a live run).
`docs/submission-checklist.md`: repo, video, screenshots, contract address, TinyFish proof.

## T8.3-B — Backend gate (backend slice)

`ruff`, `pytest`, CORS/validation/error-leakage review, backend part of
`docs/limitations.md`.

## T8.3-M — Middleware gate (middleware slice)

grep `TINYFISH_API_KEY`, `OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY`, `PRIVATE_KEY`, `.env` leaks; run
`typecheck`, `test`, `compile`, `npm audit --omit=dev`.

## T8.3-F — Frontend gate (frontend slice)

`typecheck`, `build`, `npm audit --omit=dev`; accessibility basics; chunk warning
fix or document.

## T8.3-D — Final docs (lead slice)

README/SETUP final commands; `docs/architecture.md`; `docs/limitations.md`
(demo data, no title transfer, KYC stub, testnet only); `make check` runs the fast gates.

## Finish

- Update only your own task markers `[]` → `[.]`; the lead updates phase counters.
